newsitem.title: FRANCE: GAN suspended for second time limit up.
newsitem.headline: GAN suspended for second time limit up.

text.p: Shares in French state-controlled insurer Groupe des Assurances Nationales (GAN) were suspended limit up for a second time at 0915 GMT on the Paris bourse on Friday, the SBF stock markets association said.
The new upper limit for the shares to requote at 0930 GMT would be 149.1 francs, the SBF said.
The share was suspended on Thursday, when the government announced a 20-billion-franc rescue plan for the insurer which it owns to the tune of 80 percent.
The stock was due to retrade on Friday but the "limit up" suspensions, used when a stock rises by more than 10 percent immediately kicked in.
